Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished landscape fantasy RTS concept selection sheet for the original game TEMPLE WARS. Exactly 12 DIFFERENT concepts, arranged as a strict 4 column x 3 row grid, read left to right then top to bottom. Each cell contains ONE large clearly separated full subject, entire silhouette visible, generous safe margin. Consistent elevated three-quarter front camera, hand-painted stylized 3D model reference aesthetic, chunky low-poly-friendly shapes, exaggerated readable proportions, rich wood/stone/metal/leather, restrained detail, colorful early fantasy RTS charm with original designs. Neutral warm ivory background with very faint thin grid separators, subtle grounded shadows, attractive clean art direction. Not photorealistic, not pixel art, not icons, no scenes. Readable at game camera distance. No existing franchise characters or logos. Keep weapons and appendages wholly within their cells. A compact header and each cell's exact bold code and short English name at its bottom, clear dark typography. All twelve subjects equally detailed. Generate highest useful resolution. Header text (verbatim): "TEMPLE WARS / NEW BUILDINGS". Buildings have isolated small terrain bases; creatures have no faction colors. Exact cell order and labels:
1. Label "B01 Runesmith": squat basalt runesmith forge, huge glowing cyan anvil chimney, bronze rune rings; magenta cloth accent.
2. Label "B02 Beast Lodge": timber beast trainer lodge with giant tusk doorway, saddle racks and stout pen; magenta roof pennant.
3. Label "B03 Storm Spire": stone tower with forked lightning conductor and floating blue orb; magenta banner.
4. Label "B04 Alchemist Lab": crooked compact laboratory with copper alembic, green potion tanks and glass roof; magenta awning.
5. Label "B05 War Kitchen": sturdy field kitchen hut with giant steaming cauldron, food crates and boar sign; magenta awning.
6. Label "B06 Crystal Garden": low circular garden building with three towering teal crystals, bronze channels and a keeper hut; magenta cloth.
7. Label "B07 Golem Foundry": massive squat workshop shaped around unfinished stone construct, crane and glowing kiln; magenta pennant.
8. Label "B08 Moon Observatory": round pale stone observatory, crescent brass telescope and indigo dome; magenta drapery.
9. Label "B09 Banner Hall": timber-and-stone command hall with broad hanging war standards and great central horn; magenta banners.
10. Label "B10 Spirit Grove": living hollow oak sanctuary with lantern pods, root entrance and turquoise spirit pool; magenta ribbon.
11. Label "B11 Siege Bastion": low fortified artillery emplacement with single enormous bronze mortar and stone ramparts; magenta flag.
12. Label "B12 Waygate": paired squat carved stone portal pylons on circular base with blue swirling gate and small magenta flags.
